author: GamingBolt
description:
If you’re primarily a handheld player, mainly play Nintendo games, and even dip into the AAA space (or are looking forward to The Duskbloods and that remake), then a Switch 2 really is a no-brainer. 

If you already own a Switch, you’ll have to question how much you value improved performance, access to new games, and all the extra bonuses Switch 2 editions offer. Ultimately, the Switch 2 isn’t perfect (what is?!), but a year in it’s shown itself to be a worthwhile evolution of Nintendo’s hybrid formula.
title: A Year After Its Release, Is The Nintendo Switch 2 Worth It?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is finally here. After seven years of anticipation for the next mainline entry in the beloved third person shooter series, the prequel has arrived with several significant changes and improvements under its belt, and as we discussed in our review, we’re more than a little impressed with the final product. 

E-Day delivers one of the series’ best campaign experiences and a robust multiplayer suite, and as players prepare to dive into its offerings, here, we’re going to go over a few beginner’s tips and tricks that will make your first steps into the city of Kalona a little bit smoother. With all that out of the way then, let’s get right into it, starting with a few basic pointers for newcomers that returning series fans should be plenty familiar with.
title: Gears of War: E Day - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Playing

author: GamingBolt
description:
After two years of near-silence, Dragon’s Dogma 2 is getting a new adventure with Dark Arisen. And, it’s a substantial expansion at that, bringing a frozen new region, challenging dungeons, new companions, and a host of systems designed to give you plenty of reasons to return to Vermund. 

While the DLC is clearly aimed at players who have already invested considerable time with the base game, it also introduces new approaches to vocations and buildcrafting. So, from the dangers of Norgan to the mysterious Relics scattered throughout Lost Rites, here are fifteen things you need to know about Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen. 

Some footage featured in this video is from the official TGS 2026 demo (via GamersPrey)
title: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
